{{Quote|You cannot get into it &ndash; far less fly it! It only recognizes Sint's handprints, or my own.|[[Nakia Yoru]]|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 40">[[Legacy (2006) 40|''Legacy'' (2006) 40]]</ref>}}
'''''Anzat One''''' was a transport vessel, employed by the [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] couple [[Sint Yoru|Sint]] and [[Nakia Yoru]], both [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] working for the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Lun Rask]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. In [[137 ABY]] The Yorus were [[Mission to Tatooine (Gunn Yage)|confronted]] by [[Cade Skywalker]] and [[Morrigan Corde|his mother]], with Sint Yoru being killed by Skywalker. Cade's band took the ship for themselves, painting the [[Bloody Bones (insignia)|Bloody Bones mark]] on its hull.<ref name="Legacy 2006 40">[[Legacy (2006) 40|''Legacy'' (2006) 40]]</ref>
